Package server

package server
  • Classes

    Description
    ClientInfo
    The ClientInfo class represents information about a client connected to a server.
    DBConnector
    The DBConnector class manages the connection to a MySQL database and provides methods to perform various operations related to users, orders, dishes, and restaurants.
    Server
    The Server class extends AbstractServer and handles client-server communication, processing various requests from clients, and interacting with the database via DBConnector.

    The ServerApp class is the entry point for the server-side application.
